projects.title: LivingSounds
projects.description: LivingSounds is my capstone project. This application is meant to be used by musicians who wish to incorporate something new and innovative into their scores. LivingSounds takes the sounds from the user's environment and then performs a transformation algorithm to approximate the frequencies heard into musical notes. The user can then save this output as a MIDI file, PNG image, or a text file transcription of the notes. The application was presented in a working state on 10 June 2014, but remains in development as I'm not yet ready to call it done.

projects.title: Trip to Japan
projects.description: Neumont University's Japanese Language Club traveled to Japan over the winter break to experience the culture of the nation, as well as to further practice our language skills. We spent several days in Tokyo, before heading to the Osaka/Kyoto region for several days, then we are going back to Tokyo to further explore.
